hero.headline: We connect education, innovation, and technology to solve real problems.
hero.text: Edunotech is a technology and education company helping individuals and organisations understand, adopt, and apply technology through digital solutions, artificial intelligence, learning experiences, and practical innovation.

intro.heading: More than technology. A practical approach to progress.
paragraphs: At Edunotech, we believe technology should be more than something people learn about or use occasionally. It should become a practical tool for understanding challenges, improving systems, creating opportunities, and solving problems.
Our work brings together education, digital capabilities, artificial intelligence, and innovation to help people and organisations make better use of technology.
We are interested not only in what technology can do, but also in the problems it can help us solve and the value it can create.

whatWeDo.heading: What We Do
whatWeDo.text: We work across education and technology, providing practical services and developing experiences that connect knowledge with real-world application.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: We begin by understanding the people, systems, needs, and challenges involved.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: We explore possibilities, identify opportunities, and examine what can be improved.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: We develop ideas and approaches that respond to the actual needs of the situation.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: We apply appropriate knowledge, technology, and resources to create practical solutions.

steps.title: Improve
steps.text: We evaluate, learn, and refine our work to create better outcomes over time.

programme.heading: The Problem-Solving Experience
programme.lead: What if students learned not only how to use technology, but how to recognise problems, understand them, and create solutions?
paragraphs: The Problem-Solving Experience is an educational experience powered by Edunotech. It is designed to help students develop observation, critical thinking, creativity, and practical problem-solving capabilities.
Through guided learning, reflection, practical exercises, and the application of technology, participants learn to move from identifying challenges to developing meaningful solutions.

ecic.heading: Edunotech Community Innovation Challenge (ECIC)
paragraphs: We believe young people should have the opportunity to become active contributors to the development of their communities.
The Edunotech Community Innovation Challenge (ECIC) provides a platform for secondary school students to identify challenges around them, develop practical solutions, and present their ideas.
Through ECIC, we encourage a culture of observation, responsibility, creativity, and innovation.

audiences.heading: Who We Work With
audiences.text: We welcome opportunities to work with people and organisations that believe in the practical value of education, technology, and innovation.

cta.heading: Let's create something meaningful.
cta.text: Whether you are an institution seeking technology solutions, an organisation exploring AI adoption, or a potential partner interested in education and innovation, we would love to hear from you.
